name: STMicroelectronics N.V.
blurb: STMicroelectronics is a global semiconductor group covering microcontrollers, sensors (MEMS), and — most relevant to the AI power-plumbing thesis — a broad power-semiconductor portfolio spanning SiC MOSFETs (STPOWER Gen 4), GaN devices, silicon IGBTs, and power-management ICs. ST is one of only a handful of vendors with an end-to-end 800 VDC power-conversion solution for AI data centres, offering complete reference designs from 800V bus-to-50V, 12V, and 6V conversion using its own SiC and GaN silicon. The company serves automotive, industrial, and, increasingly, hyperscale data-centre customers.
recent: ST reported Q1 2026 revenue of $3.10 billion, up 23% year-over-year and above consensus of $3.04 billion, with Q2 2026 guidance of ~$3.45 billion. In March 2026 the company announced expanded 800 VDC power-conversion products (12V and 6V architectures) developed to the NVIDIA 800 VDC reference design and showcased at NVIDIA GTC 2026. In February 2026 ST disclosed a multi-year, multi-billion-dollar engagement with Amazon Web Services to supply semiconductors for AWS compute and AI data-centre infrastructure. Management projects data-centre revenue exceeding $500 million in 2026 and surpassing $1 billion in 2027.
